mathematical_conventions.missing_data_treatment: Non-trading days (weekends, holidays) are excluded from product and count T. Halts are treated as 0% return.

inferential_limitations_under_dependent_.tracking_error_volatility: On leveraged ETFs (TQQQ, SOXL, UPRO), tracking differences between cash-diluted D2 and fully invested E0 exhibit standard deviation \sigma_{\Delta} \approx 0.80\% \text{ daily} \approx 12.7\% \text{ annualized}.
inferential_limitations_under_dependent_.consequence_of_naive_point_estimate: A sample point estimate of \Delta \widehat{\text{CAGR}} = -1.80\% (-180 bps) passes the naive check, yet its two-sided 90% confidence interval spans [-5.7%, +2.1%]. An observer claiming D2 has less than 200 bps drag is drawing a completely unsupported conclusion.

alternative_A_operational_guardrail.description: Treat \Delta \text{CAGR} \ge -200\text{ bps} strictly as an administrative risk-budget filter. If point estimate falls below -200 bps, D2 is rejected for exceeding owner's insurance cost budget, but passing is NOT described as mathematical proof of non-inferiority.
alternative_A_operational_guardrail.pros: Pragmatic, aligns with human risk tolerance, avoids pretending high statistical confidence exists on a 1-year sample.
alternative_A_operational_guardrail.cons: Does not prove true long-term drag is bounded.

alternative_B_formal_non_inferiority.description: Test H0: \mu_{\Delta} <= -0.0200 vs H1: \mu_{\Delta} > -0.0200 using Newey-West HAC lower 95% confidence bound: CI_{lower, 95%}(\Delta \text{CAGR}) > -0.0200.
alternative_B_formal_non_inferiority.cons: Severely underpowered on T = 252 sessions (power < 10%). Achieving 80% power requires > 1,500 trading sessions (> 6 years).

alternative_C_exploratory_reporting.description: Report full-period CAGR, Sharpe, Sortino, and Calmar descriptively without applying a pass/fail gate.
alternative_C_exploratory_reporting.cons: Fails to protect owner against runaway cash drag in prolonged bull markets.

owner_governance_recommendation.recommended_action: Adopt Alternative A (Operational Guardrail) with explicit preregistered wording acknowledging that it represents an empirical policy limit, not a formal statistical non-inferiority demonstration.
